newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch IT firm CSS's IPO priced at NLG 17 per share.
newsitem.headline: Dutch IT firm CSS's IPO priced at NLG 17 per share.

text.p: The initial public offering of 1.5 million shares in Dutch information technology firm Computer Services Solutions Holding NV has been priced at 17.00 guilders per share, lead manager Rabobank said on Thursday.
Rabobank reported good domestic and foreign demand for the offering which was oversubscribed several times. It had earlier published an indicative price range of 15 to 17 guilders.
The shares will be allocated to investors on Friday when they will also begin to trade on the new small companies sector of the Amsterdam stock exchange, known as the New Market.
